subject: Internet of Things (IoT)
text: CoAP is designed primarily for which environment?
optionB: Constrained devices and networks using a REST-like request/response model
explanation: Constrained Application Protocol provides a REST-like web transfer model suited to constrained devices and networks; it commonly uses UDP.

subject: Internet of Things (IoT)
text: Which characteristic is commonly associated with Zigbee?
optionB: Low-power wireless networking that can support mesh topologies
optionD: A wired serial bus requiring no radio
explanation: Zigbee is designed for low-power, low-data-rate wireless personal-area networks and supports mesh networking.

subject: Internet of Things (IoT)
text: Near Field Communication (NFC) is intended for communication over:
optionA: A very short distance, typically a few centimetres
explanation: NFC is a short-range contactless communication technology intended for close proximity, typically a few centimetres.

subject: Internet of Things (IoT)
text: IEEE 802.15.4 specifies physical and MAC layers for which class of network?
explanation: IEEE 802.15.4 defines PHY and MAC specifications for low-rate wireless personal area networks used by several IoT technologies.

subject: Internet of Things (IoT)
text: What is the primary role of a sensor node in a wireless sensor network?
optionA: To measure physical conditions and communicate observations
optionC: To allocate IP addresses to all routers
explanation: A sensor node measures environmental or physical quantities and sends observations to other nodes or a collection point.

subject: Internet of Things (IoT)
text: In an automated IoT system, what does an actuator do?
optionA: Measures temperature without producing an output
optionB: Performs a physical action in response to a control signal
optionD: Encrypts every sensor reading using DNS
explanation: An actuator converts a control signal into a physical action, such as switching a motor or opening a valve.

subject: Internet of Things (IoT)
text: Which example best represents an IoT smart-energy application?
optionA: A meter that reports electricity usage to a monitoring platform
optionC: A keyboard connected to a typewriter
explanation: A connected energy meter can report consumption data for monitoring, analysis and demand management.
